prompts.hortifruti: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE square website category illustration for a Brazilian neighborhood supermarket, premium coherent 3D product still life, softly realistic materials, warm cream background #fff8df, yellow circular plinth and a small deep purple accent #47205e, centered subjects with generous 12% safe margins on all sides, studio lighting, clean modern friendly composition. Category HORTIFRUTI: an abundant but organized cluster of fresh bananas, papaya cut in half, red tomatoes, oranges, leafy lettuce and carrots. Clearly illustrative product arrangement, not a photograph of any store. NO letters, NO words, NO logos, NO price tags, NO borders, NO people. Objects fill middle 70% of canvas and remain recognizable as a small card. Deliver a polished raster illustration.
